interface.signature: countVertex(N: int, edges: List[Tuple[int, int]]) -> int

preconditions.expression: isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 and N <= 10**5
preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(edges, list) and all(isinstance(edge, tuple) and len(edge) == 2 for edge in edges)
preconditions.description: edges is a list of tuples, where each tuple contains exactly two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(u, int) and isinstance(v, int) and 1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each element in edges is a pair of integers between 1 and N inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly N - 1, forming a valid tree.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, int) and return_value >= 1 and return_value <= N
postconditions.description: The return value is an integer between 1 and N inclusive, representing the minimum number of nodes to light up all edges.
